item.title: ZeroMQ Socket Library v3.7.1.116
item.description:
Product: ZeroMQ Socket Library v3.7.1.116
Company: Martijn Jasperse
Release Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 12:57:52 -0400
Packager: Martijn Jasperse

Description: LabVIEW bindings for ZeroMQ, the communication library that provides simple many-many messaging and other topologies.

Release Notes: - libzmq 4.3.5 built with select instead of WSAPoll;
- fixes signaler.cpp assertion crashes ("pfd.revents & POLLIN", ZeroMQ Abort then error 1097) when a client retries against a closed port.
- Static C runtime and static libsodium: no libsodium.dll or VC++ redistributable needed.
- ipc:// remains unavailable on Windows, as in 4.3.4.

*This version is a fork of labview-zmq by Martijn Jasperse, compiled by Patrick Irvin (ciozi137) with LabVIEW 2019 and VIPM 2025

item.title: RemoteControl.ZMQ v1.5.3.36
item.description:
Product: RemoteControl.ZMQ v1.5.3.36
Company: LevyLab
Release Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 12:02:25 -0400
Packager: Patrick Irvin

Description: Override library implementing ZMQ lazy pirate reliable request reply (RRR) protocal using RemoteControl SMO framework.

Release Notes: ### 1.5.3

- Fixes error 5559 ("ZMQ context owner did not start") after a socket was left open: a stuck ZeroMQ context no longer blocks new connections; a fresh context is started instead.
- Known issue: a context stuck this way can still keep LabVIEW or an application from quitting ("Resetting VI"); end it from Task Manager if that happens.

item.title: Multichannel Lockin v3.8.3.94
item.description:
Product: Multichannel Lockin v3.8.3.94
Company: LevyLab
Release Date: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 20:22:36 -0400
Packager: Patrick Irvin

Description: Multichannel Lockin for National Instruments' Dynamic Signal Acquisition hardware (4431, 4461, 4462).
- This version is configured to handle multiple cards for simultaneous, synchronized AI/AO.
- The analog outputs can be configured to output sine, square, sawtooth, or triangle functions with (swept) DC offsets.
- Each of the analog inputs can be demodulated at multiple frequencies.

Release Notes: ### 3.8.3

Rebuilt against RemoteControl.ZMQ 1.5.1.

- Fixes LabVIEW crashing ("ZeroMQ Abort", then error 1097) when a client keeps polling the lock-in while it is closed or restarting (levylabpitt/RemoteControl.ZMQ#2). Clients now wait for the lock-in to come back, reconnect within about a second once it is up, and otherwise return error 123.

Machines that run Transport or other LabVIEW clients need RemoteControl.ZMQ 1.5.1 and labview-zmq 3.7.0 installed too; the crash happens in the client, so updating the lock-in alone does not fix it.
item.dc:creator: LevyLab

item.title: RemoteControl.ZMQ v1.5.1.34
item.description:
Product: RemoteControl.ZMQ v1.5.1.34
Company: LevyLab
Release Date: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 16:54:02 -0400
Packager: Patrick Irvin

Description: Override library implementing ZMQ lazy pirate reliable request reply (RRR) protocal using RemoteControl SMO framework.

Release Notes: ### 1.5.1

Fixes LabVIEW crashing ("ZeroMQ Abort", then error 1097) when a client keeps retrying while its server is down (levylabpitt/RemoteControl.ZMQ#2).

- A client now checks that the server's port is open before creating a ZeroMQ connection, so it no longer makes refused connections inside libzmq.
- Opening a client succeeds even if the server is not running yet; the first request connects once the server is up.
- While the server is down or restarting, a request waits for it and returns error 123 if it does not come back in time (about 15 s at most).
- Fixed a socket leak on connect errors that could stop the shared ZeroMQ context from shutting down.
item.dc:creator: LevyLab

item.title: Multichannel Lockin v3.8.2.93
item.description:
Product: Multichannel Lockin v3.8.2.93
Company: LevyLab
Release Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 23:54:27 -0400
Packager: Patrick Irvin

Description: Multichannel Lockin for National Instruments' Dynamic Signal Acquisition hardware (4431, 4461, 4462).
- This version is configured to handle multiple cards for simultaneous, synchronized AI/AO.
- The analog outputs can be configured to output sine, square, sawtooth, or triangle functions with (swept) DC offsets.
- Each of the analog inputs can be demodulated at multiple frequencies.

Release Notes: ### 3.8.2

Rebuilt against RemoteControl.ZMQ 1.5.0 and labview-zmq 3.7.0 (libzmq 4.3.4).

- Fixes LabVIEW and the lock-in crashing ("ZeroMQ Abort: Socket operation on non-socket", or error 1097) when the lock-in restarts while a client such as Transport is polling it. The cause was a bug in libzmq 4.3.2 (levylabpitt/RemoteControl.ZMQ#1).
- The lock-in process now exits cleanly when closed.

Machines that run Transport or other LabVIEW clients need labview-zmq 3.7.0 and RemoteControl.ZMQ 1.5.0 installed as well; updating the lock-in alone does not fix the crash on the client side.
item.dc:creator: LevyLab

item.title: RemoteControl.ZMQ v1.5.0.33
item.description:
Product: RemoteControl.ZMQ v1.5.0.33
Company: LevyLab
Release Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 22:37:48 -0400
Packager: Patrick Irvin

Description: Override library implementing ZMQ lazy pirate reliable request reply (RRR) protocal using RemoteControl SMO framework.

Release Notes: Requires labview-zmq 3.7.0 or later (libzmq 4.3.4), which fixes LabVIEW aborting (“Socket operation on non-socket”) or error 1097 when a client is waiting while its server restarts.

- The ZMQ context is now owned by a background VI and lives until Force Cleanup or application exit. Before, it was tied to whichever VI first used ZeroMQ and stopped working for everyone when that VI stopped.
- Reconnects back off (50 ms doubling) while a server is down, instead of about 8 per second.
- Fixed a socket leak when a connect fails. Servers keep their last reply on close (LINGER 200 ms).
- The ZMQ context owner now stops after 2 s with no connections, so applications exit cleanly when closed.
item.dc:creator: LevyLab

item.title: ZeroMQ Socket Library v3.7.0.120
item.description:
Product: ZeroMQ Socket Library v3.7.0.120
Company: Martijn Jasperse
Release Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 14:00:36 -0400
Packager: Martijn Jasperse

Description: LabVIEW bindings for ZeroMQ, the communication library that provides simple many-many messaging and other topologies.

Release Notes: - Ships libzmq 4.3.4 (was 4.3.2) for 32-bit and 64-bit LabVIEW. Fixes an abort (“Socket operation on non-socket”) or error 1097 in lvzmq_recv_multi_timeout when a client is waiting while its server restarts.
- lvzmq32.dll and lvzmq64.dll are the 3.6.x binaries with their import name changed from libzmq-v120-mt-4_3_2.dll to libzmq-v120-mt-4_3_4.dll (one-byte patch, not recompiled). libsodium.dll from the same libzmq 4.3.4 release.
- Includes the 3.6.3 changes: compiled code separated from all library VIs and classes; debugging and automatic error handling disabled in all library VIs; zmq_recv_multi.vi reentrancy set to “preallocated shared”.

*This version is a fork of labview-zmq by Martijn Jasperse, compiled by Patrick Irvin (ciozi137) with LabVIEW 2019 and VIPM 2025
item.dc:creator: Martijn Jasperse
